# fpcloud_secret (Resource)

Manages a named secret in a project or an organization. The value goes in here and never comes back out: an app reaches it through an environment variable that references it (fpcloud_app's secret_env, or fpcloud_app_config's `secret`), as the variable's value or as a file the variable names. An organization secret is referenced as `org/<name>` by an app in any of the organization's projects, once the app's identity is handed it (`reader`, granted with organization write). A database's owner credential is a project secret of this kind too (<database>-owner), created with the database and rotated by its rotate-password; reference it, never manage it here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A secret in the project, referenced from an app's env by name.
resource "fpcloud_secret" "stripe" {
  project_id = fpcloud_project.web.id
  name       = "stripe-key"
  value      = var.stripe_key
}

# A secret the whole organization shares: written once, referenced as
# org/<name> by an app in any of its projects.
resource "fpcloud_secret" "sentry_dsn" {
  organization_id = fpcloud_org.example.id
  name            = "sentry-dsn"
  value           = var.sentry_dsn
}

resource "fpcloud_app" "web" {
  project_id = fpcloud_project.web.id
  name       = "web"
  image      = "ghcr.io/me/web:v1"

  secret_env = {
    STRIPE_KEY = { secret = fpcloud_secret.stripe.name }
    SENTRY_DSN = { secret = "org/${fpcloud_secret.sentry_dsn.name}" }
  }
}

# A configuration that declared fpcloud_project_secret moves without a change:
moved {
  from = fpcloud_project_secret.stripe
  to   = fpcloud_secret.stripe
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name, unique in its scope; what an env entry references (as `org/<name>` for an organization secret).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Write-only: the API never returns it, so what the configuration says is what the state holds. Changing it rolls every app referencing the secret onto the new value.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization the secret belongs to, for one written once and referenced as `org/<name>` from any of its projects. Exactly one of `project_id` and `organization_id` is set.
- `project_id` (String) Project the secret belongs to. Exactly one of `project_id` and `organization_id` is set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Secret ID.
- `scope` (String) `project` or `organization`, from which of the two ids is set.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `used_by` (List of String) Apps whose env references this secret, as `<project>/<app>` for an organization secret. The reference is the bind.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id. The value is write-only, so the first apply after an import
# writes the configuration's value, which rolls the apps referencing it.
terraform import fpcloud_secret.stripe 4b9d2e7a-1c5f-4a8e-b3d6-9f0e8c7a5b1d
```
